correctness.rationale: For 0<p<1 and 0<lambda<1 the local first-hit potential on a pinned gap [0,L] solves u_j=lambda[(1-p)u_{j-1}+p u_{j+1}], u_0=u_L=1; characteristic roots satisfy 0<r_-<1<r_+ and the displayed linear combination meets both boundary conditions. Maximum-principle comparison strictly decreases the worst-interior H(L), while the center first-hit lower bound forces H(L)->0. The threshold R exists, all feasible labelled nonempty source sets have cyclic gaps <=R, and k positive gaps summing n imply delta=ceil(n/R) and (n/k)[x^n](x+...+x^R)^k enumeration. For lambda=1/2, direct four-gap rational functions meet at p=(sqrt(17)-1)/4 and H4=(7-sqrt(17))/16; explicit H5 interior bound gives R=4 at tau=1/6 whereas p=1/2 has R=3. Independently solved exact rational full pinned n=7 cycle support and symbolic critical-bias identities; these finite instances corroborate, not replace, the all-parameter argument.
